d:
'Khalbali' from 'Rang De Basanti' is a fun fuilled video showcasing the group of friends comprising Aamir Khan, Siddharth Narayan, Sharman Joshi, Atul kulkarni, Kunal Kapoor and Soha Ali Khan having fun between cuts while working on Alice Patten's documentary. The movie is a new-age patriotic drama, directed by Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra and the music is composed by A. R. Rahman.
Song Name - Khalbali
Movie - Rang De Basanti
Singer - A.R. Rahman, Nacim & Mohammed Aslam
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricists - Prasoon Joshi & Nacim
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
